General Notes:
1. ASAP Link: https://asap.safety.af.mil/
2. CDO Turnover: 0800-0830. TW-5 BLDG RM 236. Primary CDO shall confirm with current TW-5 CDO at (850) 637-2793.
3. STANDBY: designated standby personnel shall be available by phone and in the FITU spaces within 45 minutes of official notification.
a. AM STANDBY: 0600-1100. Call the FDO for possible flight pickup at 0700 if you have not been notified. Call the FDO for release at 1100.
b. PM STANDBY: 1200-1700. Call the FDO for possible flight pickup at 1300 if you have not been notified. Call the FDO for release at 1700.
4. End of phase critique: https://cnatra.gov1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eYjHQquFKhz0PSS
IUT Syllabus Notes:
1. Exam completion is the responsibility of the IUT prior to any checkride and failure to do so will result in a Ready Room Unsat. If you need to
be scheduled for an exam, contact Schedules or the FDO to be opted. See Testing Center hours.
2. It is the responsibility of IUTs to ensure all administrative requirements to include lectures, tests, briefs and RDO visits are completed by
course completion. If you are scheduled for Testing/RDO visits, attendance is mandatory. Notify scheduling of any conflicts IOT be
rescheduled as necessary. POV/Aircraft RDO visits per instruction.
3. SNA BRIEFS OBSERVATION: IUTs are required to observe a single Student Brief/Debrief evolution in each of the following blocks: C42XX,
C43XX and I42XX for a total of three observed events. Check ANY squadron schedule for viable syllabus events.
4. CROSS COUNTRY DESIGNATION BRIEF. As scheduled in FITU spaces. IUTs can ask any IP to conduct the brief.
Academic Notes:
All class day, time, room subject to change. Always verify academic events with the printed calendar located in the academic building (BLDG 2994).
1. IFR PLANNING. IN1307/1308. Tuesday 0630-1200. BLDG 3005 RM 206.
2. CNAF LEVEL-A and EJECTION SEAT. G0102. Wednesday 0900-1130. BLDG 3155 RM 159.

3. AVIATION SAFETY PROGRAM. G0103. Monday 1000-1130. BLDG 3125 RM 112.
4. INSTRUCTOR CRM REFRESH. G0104. Every other Wednesday 1300-1400. BLDG 2946 RM 8.
PRIMARY CRM. G0104. Monday. 1215-1415. BLDG 3125 RM 112.
5. AIRSICKNESS AWARENESS. G0105. Wednesday 1130-1445. BLDG 3115 RM 159.
6. WHEELS WATCH. G0106. Monday 1130-1200. BLDG 3125 RM 112.
7. CURRICULUM REVIEW. G0107. Thursday 0930-1130. BLDG 3125 RM 112.
8. CNAF LEVEL-A REFRESHER. G0108. Every other Wednesday 0800-0900. BLDG 3155 RM 159. Attendance required during IGS.
9. FLIGHT INSTRUCTOR TRAINING COURSE (FITC). G0109. Day 1 and Day 2 (Monday and Tuesday): NAS Pensacola, Time: 0745-1600 BLDG
3258; Day 3 (Wednesday): NAS Whiting Field, Time: 0800 BLDG 3155 (FWOC) Conference Room.
10. COURSE RULES. G0201. Tuesday. 0730-1200. BLDG 3125 RM 112.
11. INSTRUCTOR IGS. G0601. Every other Wednesday 0900-1700. BLDG 3125 RM 112.
12. EKB TRAINING. Tuesdays 1030-11300. BLDG 3155 (FWOC) RM 159 (Auditorium).
13. AVIATION PHYSIOLOGY. Wednesdays: Time: 0800. Location: NAS Pensacola Bldg. 3845. Bring NATOPS jacket with current up chit.
14. AVIATION SWIMS. Coordinate date/time with ASTC and ensure you sniv and notify FITU Ops. Location: NAS Pensacola Bldg. 3944 classroom
1. Required Items: NATOPS jacket with current up chit, swimsuit, towel, extra pair of socks, and a combination lock.
